propositions: A container ticket with non-closed direct children that all declare file_impact should compute its attestation dependency set as the union of its own file_impact, review citations, and all direct children's file_impact.
If any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact, the container's dependency set must not inherit and should fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation (empty set), enforcing fail-closed semantics.
Closed children must not contribute files to the inherited union and must not trigger the poison rule, since their work is already delivered and completion-audited.

The children list must be threaded from the orchestrator's assembled context through sign_plan_review to dependency_hashes without new store reads, and absent children (resign path) must conservatively skip inheritance.

P9 must surface an advisory (non-blocking) on containers with poisoned inheritance, naming the child IDs with empty file_impact, while containers with effective inheritance pass and leaves remain unchanged.
A child's file_impact edit after container review must invalidate the container's attestation via pin/material drift, forcing re-review that recomputes the inherited union.
